chapter.li: LEChapter1 Verse1 Now I Moroni will next give an account of those ancient inhabitants who were destroyed by the Lord’s hand in this northern land. VerseEnd Verse2 I’m taking my account from the 24 plates found by Limhi’s people — and this is called the book of Ether. VerseEnd Verse3 Because I believe the first part of this record is also part of the record of the Jews (which has to do with the creation of the world and Adam, and contains an account from that time up until the great tower, and everything that happened among mankind up to that time), VerseEnd Verse4 I’m not including anything that happened from Adam’s time until then. But they’re included on the plates, and whoever finds them will be able to read the full account. VerseEnd Verse5 Therefore I’m not giving the full account, only a partial account, from the time of the tower until they were destroyed. VerseEnd

Verse6 This is how I summarize their record: The one who wrote this record was Ether, and he was a descendant of Coriantor. VerseEnd Verse7 Coriantor was the son of Moron; VerseEnd Verse8 Moron was the son of Ethem; VerseEnd Verse9 Ethem was the son of Ahah; VerseEnd Verse10 Ahah was the son of Seth; VerseEnd Verse11 Seth was the son of Shiblon; VerseEnd Verse12 Shiblon was the son of Com; VerseEnd Verse13 Com was the son of Coriantum; VerseEnd Verse14 Coriantum was the son of Amnigaddah; VerseEnd Verse15 and Amnigaddah was the son of Aaron. VerseEnd Verse16 Aaron was a descendant of Heth, who was the son of Hearthom. VerseEnd Verse17 Hearthom was the son of Lib; VerseEnd Verse18 Lib was the son of Kish; VerseEnd Verse19 Kish was the son of Corom; VerseEnd Verse20 Corom was the son of Levi; VerseEnd Verse21 Levi was the son of Kim, VerseEnd Verse22 and Kim was the son of Morianton. VerseEnd Verse23 Morianton was a descendant of Riplakish; VerseEnd Verse24 Riplakish was the son of Shez; VerseEnd Verse25 Shez was the son of Heth; VerseEnd Verse26 Heth was the son of Com; VerseEnd Verse27 Com was the son of Coriantum; VerseEnd Verse28 Coriantum was the son of Emer; VerseEnd Verse29 Emer was the son of Omer; VerseEnd Verse30 Omer was the son of Shule; VerseEnd Verse31 Shule was the son of Kib; VerseEnd Verse32 Kib was the son of Orihah, who was the son of Jared, VerseEnd Verse33 and this Jared came out from the great tower with his brother and their families, along with some others and their families, when the Lord confused the people’s language and made an oath, in His wrath, to scatter them throughout the world; and so the people were scattered. VerseEnd

Verse34 Jared’s brother was a large and powerful man, and because he was very blessed by the Lord, Jared said to him: Cry to the Lord in prayer and ask Him to not let us become confused and unable to keep a clear understanding of our language. VerseEnd Verse35 Jared’s brother cried to the Lord in prayer, and the Lord had compassion on Jared. As a result, He didn’t confuse Jared’s language, and Jared and his brother weren’t disconnected. VerseEnd Verse36 Then Jared told his brother: Cry to the Lord again in prayer — perhaps He’ll turn His anger away from those who are our friends and not confuse their language. VerseEnd Verse37 Jared’s brother cried to the Lord in prayer, and the Lord had compassion on their friends and families as well so that they weren’t divided and disconnected. VerseEnd Verse38 Jared again said to his brother: Go and ask the Lord whether He intends to lead us out of the land. If He does intend to lead us out of the land, ask Him: Where are we to go? And who knows, it’s possible the Lord will lead us to a land that’s specially chosen and better than all other places on earth. If so, let’s be faithful to the Lord, so we can receive it from Him. VerseEnd Verse39 And Jared’s brother cried to the Lord in prayer, in accordance with what Jared asked. VerseEnd Verse40 The Lord heard Jared’s brother and had sympathy on him and told him: VerseEnd Verse41 Get to work and gather 2PSI your flocks of every kind, both male and female; and seeds of every kind; and 2PSI your family, and 2PSI your brother Jared and his family, and 2PSI your friends and their families, and Jared’s friends and their families. VerseEnd

Verse42 When 2PSI you’ve done this, 2PSI you must lead them down into the valley to the north. I’ll meet 2PSI you there and lead 2PSI you to a land that’s specially chosen and better than all other places on earth. VerseEnd Verse43 I’ll bless 2PSI you and 2PSI your descendants there and raise up a great nation to Me from 2PSI your descendants, 2PSI your brother’s descendants, and from those who go with 2PSI you. No other nation on earth will be greater than the one I’ll raise up to Me from 2PSI your descendants. I’ll do this for 2PSI you because of 2PP your persistent prayers. VerseEnd

LEChapter2 Verse1 Then Jared and his brother and their families, as well as the friends of Jared and his brother and their families, went down into the valley to the north. The name of the valley was Nimrod, being named for the powerful hunter. They traveled with their flocks of every kind they had gathered, male and female. VerseEnd Verse2 They also laid snares and caught birds. They also prepared a vessel, in which they carried fish. VerseEnd Verse3 They also took with them deseret — a word that means honey bee. So they took with them swarms of bees and a variety of seeds they gathered from the land. VerseEnd

Verse4 When they had come down into the valley of Nimrod, the Lord came down and talked with Jared’s brother. He was in a cloud and Jared’s brother didn’t see Him. VerseEnd Verse5 The Lord commanded them to travel into the wilderness, to a region where no one had ever been. The Lord led them, talking with them as He stood in a cloud, giving them directions on where to travel. VerseEnd Verse6 They traveled in the wilderness and built small ships, crossing many bodies of water in these ships while being continually guided by the Lord. VerseEnd Verse7 The Lord wouldn’t allow them to remain in the wilderness beyond the sea, but His desire was for them to proceed all the way to the land of promise, which was specially chosen and better than all other places on earth, which the Lord God had saved for a righteous people. VerseEnd Verse8 He had sworn in His wrath to Jared’s brother that whoever occupied this land of promise, from that time forward and forever, must serve Him, the true and only God, or they would be swept away when they provoked His full wrath upon them. VerseEnd

Verse9 Now we’ll witness God’s decrees concerning this land, and whoever occupies this land of promise must serve God, or they’ll be swept away when they provoke His full wrath upon them. The full extent of God’s wrath will be provoked when they’ve ripened in iniquity. VerseEnd Verse10 This is a land that’s specially chosen and better than all other places on earth. That being the case, those who inhabit it must serve God or they’ll be swept away because of God’s everlasting decree. But they aren’t swept away until there’s a fullness of iniquity among the occupants of the land. VerseEnd Verse11 This is coming to 2PP you, Gentiles, so 2PP you can know God’s decrees, so 2PP you can repent and not continue in 2PP your iniquities until the fullness has come, so 2PP you don’t provoke the full extent of God’s wrath upon 2PP you as the inhabitants of the land have all done before. VerseEnd Verse12 This is a choice land; and any nation that inhabits it will be free from enslavement and captivity and from all other nations under heaven if they will only serve the God of the land, who is Jesus Christ, who’s been revealed to 2PP you through the things we’ve written. VerseEnd

Verse13 Now I’ll continue with my record. The Lord brought Jared and his companions all the way to the great sea separating land masses. When they arrived at the sea, they pitched their tents and named the place Moriancumer. They lived in tents at the seashore for four years. VerseEnd Verse14 Then at the end of the four years, the Lord again came to Jared’s brother and stood in a cloud and talked with him. The Lord talked with Jared’s brother for three hours and chastised him because he didn’t remember to call on the Lord’s name. VerseEnd Verse15 Jared’s brother repented of that evil and called on the Lord’s name on behalf of his companions who were with him. The Lord said to him: I’ll forgive 2PSI you and 2PSI your companions of their sins, but 2PSI you must not sin anymore. 2PP You must remember that My Spirit won’t always influence mankind. Verse16 Then the Lord said: Go to work and build small ships like 2PP you’ve built before. The bottom part of each ship was watertight like a bowl, and the sides were also watertight like a bowl, and the ends were peaked, and the top was watertight like a bowl, and the length of each ship was the length of a tree, and the doors — when shut — were watertight, like a bowl. VerseEnd Verse18 Then Jared’s brother cried out to the Lord, saying: O Lord, I’ve finished the work 2PSI You’ve commanded me to do, and I’ve made the ships as 2PSI You’ve directed me. VerseEnd Verse19 But, O Lord, there’s no light in them. How will we steer? We’ll suffocate, because we only have the limited air inside them to breathe; therefore we’ll die. VerseEnd Verse20 The Lord said to Jared’s brother: Make a hole in the front and back of each ship. Whenever 2PG you need more air, unplug the holes to let in air. If water rushes in on 2PG you, plug the hole so 2PG you don’t sink from the water that comes pouring in. VerseEnd

Verse21 Jared’s brother did as the Lord commanded. VerseEnd Verse22 Then he cried out again to the Lord, saying: O Lord, I’ve done just as 2PSI You’ve commanded and prepared the ships for my people. But there’s no light in them. O Lord, are 2PSI You going to let us cross the sea in darkness? VerseEnd Verse23 The Lord asked Jared’s brother: What do 2PP you want Me to do to provide light in 2PP your ships? 2PP You can’t have windows, since they would be dashed into pieces. 2PP You aren’t to use fire, since 2PP you can’t light a fire. VerseEnd Verse24 2PP You’ll be like a whale in the sea, with mountainous waves crashing over 2PP you. However, I’ll protect 2PP you as 2PP you cross the deep sea; because the winds blow at My word, and I also control the rains and floods. LEChapter3 Verse1 Now there were eight ships prepared. He carried them in his hands up to the top of the mountain and cried out again to the Lord, saying: VerseEnd Verse2 O Lord, 2PSI You’ve said the sea will surround us. Verse13 When he had said these words, the Lord showed Himself to him and said: Because 2PSI you know these things, 2PSF you are redeemed from the Fall. Verse17 Now as I Moroni told 2PP you I couldn’t make a full account of this record, therefore it’s enough for me to say Jesus showed Himself to this man in the Spirit, in the same way and in the same bodily form as He showed Himself to the Nephites. Verse21 The Lord said to Jared’s brother: 2PSF You must not allow these things that 2PSF you’ve seen and heard to be revealed to the world until the time comes when I glorify My name in the flesh. VerseEnd Verse23 And I provide 2PSF you with these two stones to also seal up with the things 2PSF you write. VerseEnd Verse24 I made the language 2PSF you write in impossible for others to understand. Therefore I’ll use these stones, at the right time, to let people understand what 2PSF you write. VerseEnd Verse26 The Lord had previously told him that if he would believe in Him, if he would believe He could show him all things, then they would be shown to him. Therefore the Lord couldn’t keep anything from him since he knew the Lord could show him all things. VerseEnd

Verse27 The Lord told him: Write these things down and seal them up under My care; I’ll reveal them at the right time to mankind. VerseEnd Verse28 And the Lord commanded him to seal up the two stones he had received and hide them until the Lord provides them to mankind. VerseEnd LEChapter4 Verse1 Then the Lord commanded Jared’s brother to descend the mountain from the Lord’s presence and write everything he had seen. And they were forbidden to come to mankind until after He had been lifted up on the cross. This is the reason king Benjamin kept them secure, so they wouldn’t be known to the world until after Christ showed Himself to His people. VerseEnd Verse2 After Christ had truly shown Himself to His people, He commanded them to be revealed. VerseEnd

Verse3 Now after they’ve all dwindled in unbelief and only Lamanites remain, who have rejected Christ’s gospel — I’ve been commanded to hide them away again in the ground. VerseEnd Verse4 I’ve written on these plates the very things Jared’s brother saw. Greater things were never revealed than those things revealed to Jared’s brother. VerseEnd Verse5 Therefore the Lord has commanded me to write them down and I’ve written them. He also commanded me to seal them up under His care. He has also commanded me to protect the ability to translate them, so I’ve sealed the Interpreters according to the Lord’s commandment. VerseEnd Verse6 The Lord told me: They must not go to the Gentiles until they repent of their iniquity and become clean before the Lord. VerseEnd Verse7 The Lord said: When they exercise faith in Me, just as Jared’s brother did, so that they become sanctified in Me, then I’ll show them the things Jared’s brother saw, even providing all My revelations to them. This is what Jesus Christ said, who’s the Son of God the Father of the heavens and the earth, and everything in them. VerseEnd

Verse8 Let any who fight against the Lord’s word be cursed. And any who deny these things, let them be cursed, as Jesus Christ has said: I won’t show any greater things to them for I Am the one who speaks. VerseEnd Verse9 At My command, the heavens open and shut, and at My word the earth will shake. At My command, those living on earth will die by fire. VerseEnd Verse10 Those who don’t believe My words don’t believe My disciples. If 2PP you think I don’t speak, decide for yourself; but 2PP you’ll know on the last day that I Am the one who speaks. VerseEnd Verse11 And I’ll visit those who believe the things I’ve spoken by the manifestations of My Spirit. VerseEnd Verse12 Anything that persuades people to do good comes from Me, because good comes from no one other than Me. I Am the same one who leads people to everything good.

Those who refuse to believe My words won’t believe in Me, that I Am. And those who refuse to believe in Me won’t believe in the Father, who sent Me. For I Am the Father. I Am the light, the life, and the truth of the world. VerseEnd Verse13 Come to Me, Gentiles, and I’ll show 2PP you the greater things, knowledge that’s hidden away because of unbelief. VerseEnd Verse14 Come to Me, O house of Israel, and it will be revealed to 2PP you how the Father has great things in store for 2PP you from the foundation of creation that 2PP you haven’t received because of unbelief. VerseEnd Verse15 When 2PP you move aside the veil of unbelief that causes 2PP you to remain in 2PP your awful state of wickedness and hardness of heart and blindness of mind, then the great and miraculous things that have been hidden away from 2PP you from the foundation of creation will come to 2PP you. When 2PP you call on the Father in My name with a broken heart and a contrite spirit, then 2PP you’ll know, O house of Israel, that the Father remembers the covenant He made to 2PP your fathers. VerseEnd Verse16 Then the revelations I had My servant John write will be understood by everyone. Remember, when 2PP you see these things, 2PP you’ll know that the time is near when they will be revealed. VerseEnd Verse17 Therefore when 2PP you receive this record, 2PP you can know the Father’s work has begun throughout the land. VerseEnd Verse18 So repent, everyone, throughout the world. VerseEnd Verse19 Those who are found faithful to My name on the last day will be blessed, for they’ll be lifted up to live in the kingdom prepared for them from the foundation of creation.
